Source: configured Steam PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 and classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000.
Full instruction bodies and literal/call operands accompany this reconstruction.

Compact Announcements/Done renderer:
  Steam RVA 883f40..884458; classic RVA 8817c0..881cd8.
  This modal owns a vector<adv_announcementst*> at this+8..this+10.
  Each entry owns a native string at +0 and its parent report pointer at +20.
  Steam 8842c2..8842e9 obtains the text color from parent+28/+2a.
  Steam 8842f0..884310 passes entry.str to addst when its length at +10 is
  nonzero; otherwise it passes parent.report.text at parent+8.
  Steam 884315..884321 advances exactly one screen row for each vector entry.
  The scroll position is this+24. It selects vector entries, not independent
  semantic announcement sentences. Wrapped entries retain their parent.

Finite renderer text branches:
  Announcements: always rendered title, Steam 8841fb..88422d.
  Done: always rendered button, Steam 88416b..884184 (inline immediate).

Translation consequence:
  A successfully translated physical first row does not prove the parent
  record has ended. The renderer entry supplies the current owner; its vector
  gives every native wrap entry's parent and complete report::text. Keep this
  borrowed owner within the draw epoch, then match the actual string draw
  addresses and project the complete translation through the visible rows.
  Scrolled tails and clipped final lines retain the same complete parent.
  Where direct ownership is unavailable, compose only rows that reproduce a
  captured/history parent record exactly, before attempting translation.
  Prefix-only candidates do not authorize consuming neighbouring entries.
  The per-constructor grammar then resolves the complete typed fields.

The other title owner (Steam 234ad0, classic 234a60) is the settings tab
constructor. Its full assembly is retained to distinguish title references;
it does not own this compact log or its announcement texts.
